question: Is the increased group count under fixed expert protection necessary, or can loading missing protected experts last remove execution tax and improve complete requests?
basis: Prior frequency810/decode826 groups per episode; exact current-call construction suggests713/728 while preserving each current entry miss loaded once. This is not a future trajectory replay.
action: Keep selector unchanged, preserve entry-resident protected slots, execute unprotected resident/missing experts first, execute all protected experts in the final group; no extra expert/KV allocation.
